mentions.name: Fully open-sourced website
mentions.description: A long-running website that has been the author's livelihood since 2020, now being fully open-sourced so anyone can use and run the code.
mentions.problem: Audience loss and declining traffic caused by LLMs are making the site's future unsustainable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working to fully open-source the website I've been living from since 2020. I'm not as worried about copycat websites anymore since big tech has stolen all of my work already, so I'm losing my audience either way.
